about: Now playing (QOL A00.1): one voice note / audio clip / video plays at a time, and starting a recording pauses whatever plays. Replayed by the desktop (tools/now-playing-test.mjs on crates/app/qml/NowPlaying.qml) and Tin Hat Web (src/features/chat/lib/nowPlaying.test.ts). A case runs its ops from {cur: null}; out = the ids asked to pause, in order; cur = who plays at the end.

cases.name: a second player pauses the first
a third player pauses only the one playing
the same player again (resume, seek) pauses nothing
a player that ended lets the next start freely
an old player's late end doesn't clear the one playing
recording with nothing playing pauses nothing
recording after the player ended pauses nothing
playing after a recording started pauses nothing
end of a player that never played is ignored
